;*******************************************************************************************************************************
;** Coverage: display rounding under DRM of a complex X, rectangular. ROUND keeps the digits the line shows on each part.     **
;** RXTP checks the stored text of the real part, then of the imaginary part. DRM 0 to 6; FIX 2 and 4, FIX 2 under ENGOVR,    **
;** ENG 2, SIG 3 with TRL0 set and clear, SIG 3 over range under ENGOVR with TRL0 set and clear; the imaginary part takes the **
;** next point of the six, so each point is on both parts; all four sign pairs. The SCI route, F1, and a polar complex, F2,   **
;** are at the end. Expected: Python decimal, probe/drm_model.py and probe/gen_drm_ext_cov.py.                                **
;*******************************************************************************************************************************

In: FL_SPCRES=0 FL_CPXRES=0 SD=0 RMODE=0 IM=2compl SS=4 WS=64 FL_FRACT=0

In:  FL_ASLIFT=0 RX=Real:"1"
Out: EC=0

Func: fnRound
